{
  "candidate_rtl": "module mul_subexpression(
    input [7:0] multiplicand,
    input [7:0] multiplier,
    output [15:0] product
);

// Heights of the unsigned partial-product heap after Dadda reductions.
function automatic integer height(input integer stage, input integer column);
    integer h [0:15];
    integer nh [0:15];
    integer s, k, target, incoming, excess;
    begin
        for (k = 0; k < 16; k = k + 1)
            h[k] = (k < 8) ? k + 1 : 15 - k;
        for (s = 0; s < stage; s = s + 1) begin
            case (s)
                0: target = 6;
                1: target = 4;
                2: target = 3;
                default: target = 2;
            endcase
            incoming = 0;
            for (k = 0; k < 16; k = k + 1) begin
                excess = h[k] + incoming - target;
                if (excess > 0) begin
                    nh[k] = target;
                    incoming = (excess + 1) / 2;
                end else begin
                    nh[k] = h[k] + incoming;
                    incoming = 0;
                end
            end
            for (k = 0; k < 16; k = k + 1)
                h[k] = nh[k];
        end
        height = h[column];
    end
endfunction

function automatic integer incoming_count(input integer stage, input integer column);
    integer k, target, n, excess;
    begin
        case (stage)
            0: target = 6;
            1: target = 4;
            2: target = 3;
            default: target = 2;
        endcase
        n = 0;
        for (k = 0; k < column; k = k + 1) begin
            excess = height(stage, k) + n - target;
            n = (excess > 0) ? (excess + 1) / 2 : 0;
        end
        incoming_count = n;
    end
endfunction

wire [7:0] heap [0:4][0:15];
wire [7:0] carry_bits [0:3][0:16];
genvar c, r, s, f, u;
generate
    for (c = 0; c < 16; c = c + 1) begin: partial_column
        localparam integer LOW = (c > 7) ? c - 7 : 0;
        localparam integer N = (c < 8) ? c + 1 : 15 - c;
        for (r = 0; r < N; r = r + 1) begin: bit_product
            assign heap[0][c][r] = multiplicand[LOW+r] & multiplier[c-LOW-r];
        end
        for (r = N; r < 8; r = r + 1) begin: unused
            assign heap[0][c][r] = 1'b0;
        end
    end
    for (s = 0; s < 4; s = s + 1) begin: reduction
        localparam integer TARGET = (s == 0) ? 6 : (s == 1) ? 4 : (s == 2) ? 3 : 2;
        assign carry_bits[s][0] = 8'b0;
        for (c = 0; c < 16; c = c + 1) begin: column
            localparam integer N = height(s,c);
            localparam integer INC = incoming_count(s,c);
            localparam integer EX = (N + INC > TARGET) ? N + INC - TARGET : 0;
            localparam integer NF = EX / 2;
            localparam integer NH = EX % 2;
            localparam integer REM = N - 3*NF - 2*NH;
            localparam integer OUT = NF + NH + REM + INC;
            for (f = 0; f < NF; f = f + 1) begin: full_adder
                wire a, b, d;
                assign a = heap[s][c][3*f];
                assign b = heap[s][c][3*f+1];
                assign d = heap[s][c][3*f+2];
                assign heap[s+1][c][f] = a ^ b ^ d;
                assign carry_bits[s][c+1][f] = (a & b) | (a & d) | (b & d);
            end
            if (NH != 0) begin: half_adder
                assign heap[s+1][c][NF] = heap[s][c][3*NF] ^ heap[s][c][3*NF+1];
                assign carry_bits[s][c+1][NF] = heap[s][c][3*NF] & heap[s][c][3*NF+1];
            end
            for (u = 0; u < REM; u = u + 1) begin: remaining
                assign heap[s+1][c][NF+NH+u] = heap[s][c][3*NF+2*NH+u];
            end
            for (u = 0; u < INC; u = u + 1) begin: incoming
                assign heap[s+1][c][NF+NH+REM+u] = carry_bits[s][c][u];
            end
            for (u = OUT; u < 8; u = u + 1) begin: padding
                assign heap[s+1][c][u] = 1'b0;
            end
            for (u = NF+NH; u < 8; u = u + 1) begin: carry_padding
                assign carry_bits[s][c+1][u] = 1'b0;
            end
        end
    end
endgenerate

// Only the final two rows require carry propagation.
wire [15:0] a, b, bit_sum;
wire [15:0] p [0:4];
wire [15:0] g [0:4];
generate
    for (c = 0; c < 16; c = c + 1) begin: final_rows
        assign a[c] = heap[4][c][0];
        assign b[c] = heap[4][c][1];
    end
endgenerate
assign bit_sum = a ^ b;
assign p[0] = a | b;
assign g[0] = a & b;
generate
    for (s = 0; s < 4; s = s + 1) begin: prefix_level
        for (c = 0; c < 16; c = c + 1) begin: prefix_bit
            if (c >= (1 << s)) begin: combine
                assign g[s+1][c] = g[s][c] | (p[s][c] & g[s][c-(1 << s)]);
                assign p[s+1][c] = p[s][c] & p[s][c-(1 << s)];
            end else begin: pass_through
                assign g[s+1][c] = g[s][c];
                assign p[s+1][c] = p[s][c];
            end
        end
    end
endgenerate
assign product = bit_sum ^ {g[4][14:0],1'b0};
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The previous balanced addition tree still propagates carries in intermediate sums. Its measured critical path combines partial-product buffering, compressor-like logic and a final carry network, reaching 2.44 ns.",
  "rewrite": "Replace intermediate carry-propagating additions with an explicit column-wise Dadda reduction using target heights 6, 4, 3 and 2. Full and half adders retain carries as separate heap bits. Add the final two rows with a four-level parallel-prefix carry network; OR propagation allows carry generation to proceed independently of the final sum XOR.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to reduce arrival time by eliminating intermediate carry propagation and bounding final carry depth. Improvement over 2.44 ns is a design expectation, not a measured result; mapped STA is required to quantify it.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "The sparse Dadda heap limits compressor count, while the explicit prefix network trades additional parallel carry logic and wiring for timing. Intended to remain within 3761.482560 um2, but mapped area and zero max-slew/max-capacitance violations require evaluation.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the module name and unsigned 8-bit input and 16-bit output ports. Computes the exact unsigned product for all 65,536 input pairs, including zero and maximum operands. All partial-product weights and carries are retained through bit 15; any carry beyond the output width is discarded consistently with the original 16-bit arithmetic. No parameters, state, latency, assumptions or external dependencies are introduced."
}
